It is located in [[Izu Province]].

It is identified with the {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} "Haji Shrine" (??????)<ref name="kyoiku">[https://www.kyoiku.metro.tokyo.lg.jp/administration/osima/hajikamajinja.html Hajikama Shrine] - Tokyo Metropolitan Board of Education</ref><ref name="geo">[https://izuoshima-geo.org/know/highlights/culturalsite/bunkasite-9.html Hajikama Shrine] - Izu Oshima Geopark</ref><ref name="navi">[https://oshima-navi.com/shrine/shrine004.html Hajikama Shrine] - Izu Oshima Navi</ref>.

== Enshrined deity ==
* Haji-no-Mikoto (??????) - second son of {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi-no-Kami}} (Mishima Daimy?jin) and one consort, Habuhime-no-Mikoto (deity of {{ill|Habuhime-no-Mikoto Shrine|Q134930157|qid=Q134930157}}). His elder brother is Ajiko-no-Mikoto, deity of {{ill|Omiya Shrine|Q131925939|qid=Q131925939|lt=?miya Shrine}}.
